volunteer.title: Volunteering with WE HELP
volunteer.cost: There is no cost to volunteer.
volunteer.availability: Information sessions run on a rolling basis. Your nearest session is on {{nextSession}}.
steps: A volunteer coordinator will contact you on your preferred date to talk through the role.
You will be invited to an information session and asked to complete an application.
Successful applicants complete training before taking any calls or texts.

sponsor.title: Sponsoring WE HELP
sponsor.cost: Your pledge of R{{amount}} a month is R{{yearly}} over a year.
sponsor.availability: Pledges can start on any date. We will confirm your pledge in writing.

tiers.name: Friend
tiers.text: Helps keep the text line and hotline running.

tiers.name: Supporter
tiers.text: Helps fund training for new volunteers.

tiers.name: Partner
tiers.text: Helps connect more people to professional therapy.

steps: Our partnerships team will contact you on your preferred date.
We will send you a pledge form to confirm the amount and start date.

therapy.title: Therapy referral
therapy.cost: WE HELP does not charge to connect you with a therapist. Therapists set their own fees, so please ask about options such as medical aid cover or reduced-fee sessions.
therapy.availability: Our text line and hotline are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week while we match you with a therapist.
steps: A member of our team will contact you on your preferred date to understand what you need.
We will share a short list of professionals who may be a good fit.
You choose who to contact. There is no pressure and no obligation.

info.title: About our text line and hotline
info.cost: Contacting WE HELP does not require a diagnosis, and no problem is too small.
info.availability: Both the text line and the hotline are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
steps: Call 072 055 37 17, or text "HELP" to the same number, at any time.
If you are in immediate danger, call 112, Police 10111 or Ambulance 10177 first.
